heroSubtitle: Two dedicated tools working in perfect unison. Capture physical geometry in real-world spaces with our mobile app, and apply pro-grade textures, colors, and designs on your desktop device.

mobile.description: Transform your physical sneaker collection into high-fidelity 3D digital twins. Just take a series of photos of any shoe using your mobile phone, and let our photogrammetry engine do the rest.
mobile.spec2: LiDAR scanning integration for depth mapping
mobile.spec3: Auto-extraction of upper mesh and sole boundaries
mobile.spec4: Instant upload & sync to secure Cloud Vault

desktop.description: The ultimate 3D shoe customizer interface. Load your synced mobile scans instantly, map colors, modify materials, apply custom graphics, and export print-ready assets.
desktop.spec2: Multi-layer canvas painting and custom stickers overlay
desktop.spec3: GLTF, OBJ, FBX, and Apple USDZ 3D model exports
desktop.spec4: Local daemon compiler server listening on port 8421
desktop.windowsMeta: Windows 10/11 (64-bit) • The 3D renderer (about 400 MB) downloads on first launch
desktop.macComingSoon: KusShoes Editor for macOS is coming soon. For now, please use a Windows PC.
desktop.noInstallerYet: The first Windows installer is being prepared. Please check back soon.
desktop.smartScreenHint: If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, click More info → Run anyway.

workflow.title: How They Sync
workflow.desc: When you scan a sneaker using the mobile <b1>KusShoes App</b1>, the photogrammetry scans compile directly in our Cloud Vault. Upon launching <b2>KusStudio Desktop</b2>, the application detects your active cloud workspace and syncs all scans in less than 3 seconds. The desktop suite also hosts a local listener that communicates directly with your portal web browser.
